assessment_details.rationale: O has no matched CPO distributed-regularizer trainer-namespace repair, tied-alias mask/reference bookkeeping, or PyTorch namespace migration mechanism.
O has scoped evidence gates and adaptive strategy selection, but no matched Fixed Share path prior with an exact realized mixability-gap certificate.
O already rejects vacuous or mis-scoped evidence and tracks budget/cost, but has no matched theorem-tuning-vs-realized-certificate analysis for shifting-expert proposal control.
O adapts routes and strategies under evidence, but has no matched aggressive Fixed Share controller or recurring-drift held-out variance study.
O uses falsifiable evidence and rollback, but has no matched online realized mixability certificate that conditionally justifies an aggressive controller.
O compares alternate methods after saturation, but has no matched AdaNormalHedge.TV shifting-expert controller or this finite-sample negative comparison.
O has invocation journals, immutable requests and fail-closed evaluation state, but no matched RESERVE/SLOT/COMMIT reservation-compliance auditor at the scientific-row layer.
O has replay/idempotency and durable close/checkpoint machinery, but no matched compliance CLOSE that rederives reservation evidence and fail-closes bypassed slots.

O aligns repository continuation/context with recovery and preserves side-effect idempotency, but has no matched joint agent-context plus controlled-environment rewind mechanism or corresponding ablation.
O explicitly uses invocation journals, idempotency and effect-bound dispatch safeguards, but has no matched semantic-equivalence replay-or-fork fence for post-restore regenerated actions.

O has durable traces, context routing and recovery classification, but no matched learned FSM whose replay fitness is separated from failure prediction and whose local projection is compared with full context.
O already requires held-out/independent evidence and rollback, but has no matched harness-optimizer benchmark with hidden acceptance partitions and scarce-resource accounting.
O has recovery classes and reversible safeguards, but no matched same-suite evidence that retry/schema/injection mitigations interact non-monotonically by fault class.
O already retries, switches routes and can defer/abstain under constraints, but has no matched learned retry/switch/abstain recoverability classifier under controlled tool faults.

O has fence/CAS, identity binding, revocation and effect-dispatch projections, but no matched two-axis concrete-event repair/effect-permission witness with omission/replay stress and evidence monotonicity tests.
O has no matched four-state volatility/stochasticity latent filter or duration-regime posterior mechanism.
O has no matched broad stochasticity-mixture controller for separating noise from regime change.
O has no matched residual-autocorrelation heuristic for volatility/stochasticity attribution or its negative stress result.
O has durable replay, canonical identities and fenced reconstruction, but no matched sink-owned event-log identity plus projection cursor reconciliation across fresh sink instances.
O has durable replay and reconstruction, but no matched all-generation rotated-log bootstrap with cursor-miss full rebuild and explicit lock-order safety.
O has no matched canonical-log fsync-before-derived-view power-loss durability harness; its current durability path is primarily remote Git/CAS rather than this local file-ordering mechanism.
O has no BDD order-portfolio experiment showing a diverse third start fails to transfer on a fresh graph-family holdout.
O has no structural width gate for selectively opening a diverse BDD ordering arm.
O has candidate/route selection and cost-aware strategy review, but no matched cheap learned structural gate that predicts rare expensive restart value under frozen cross-size held-out evaluation.
O has comparative method selection, but no matched width-baseline-vs-learned-gate negative cross-check for BDD restart routing.
O explicitly detects exploration bias and changes method families, but has no matched confidence-gated diversity-to-uncertainty acquisition schedule with redundancy control.

O has immutable Work identities, journals, idempotency and evidence ledgers, but no matched authoritative semantically fingerprinted paired-comparison event log from which anytime-valid gate state is derived.
